a test through the real step order is red before the change
fix: Design first: run the code-index refresh after the rebuild step, or have sync-main build and use the merged binary for the refresh; a red test where the merged policy holds a key the old binary does not know, through the real wave next step order.
summary: On 2026-11-16 the wave-176 boundary stopped at step 4 (sync-main): the merge was done, but the code-index refresh parsed the merged .evolve/policy.json with the old plane binary, which refused the new key catalog.tier_pins (from #1471). wave next rebuilds the binary only at step 11, after sync-main. The console rebuilt go/bin/evolve by hand and re-ran wave next.
title: A boundary that merges a new policy key does not stop at sync-main
